verification: Mocked: fixture-local vaults in CI; no live swarm, brain-api pod or vault.
assertions: A commit killed midway completes from its journal exactly once and matches an uninterrupted apply of the same vault.
The next tick apply finishes a pending journal before its own batch.
A target changed after staging keeps its newer content and the replay counts it as a conflict.
Staged files without a journal are discarded and the previous revision stays.
